name: agent-msg-bus-inbox
description: Shows how much agent-msg-bus mail is waiting for this session, in the status line and a toast, without starting a model turn.

binary.title: agent-msg-bus binary
binary.description: Path to the agent-msg-bus binary. Empty: %LOCALAPPDATA%\agent-msg-bus\agent-msg-bus.exe where LOCALAPPDATA is set, otherwise agent-msg-bus on PATH.

mode.title: How mail is noticed
mode.description: poll reads the inbox on a timer and holds nothing open. watch keeps `agent-msg-bus watch` running for the session, which subscribes the session's address: it shows as live in peers, and a second session in the same repo gets its own fallback address.

intervalSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often poll mode reads the inbox; 15 at least. Watch mode re-reads every 5 minutes as well, as a check on the watch.
